name: Meeting Notes
summary: Record meetings or import audio; on-device English, Hindi and Hinglish transcripts, AI notes and questions.

permissions.name: android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO
permissions.reason: Records meetings when you tap Record

permissions.name: android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS
permissions.reason: Shows the recording notification Android requires

permissions.name: android.permission.INTERNET
permissions.reason: Downloads the English speech model once

permissions.name: com.google.android.apps.aicore.service.BIND_SERVICE
permissions.reason: Uses Gemini Nano on phones that have it (off by default)

privacy: Everything stays on the phone. See PRIVACY.md in the repository.
